integration_hooks.validator_timing: Before credentials, sessions, planner-selected content reads, or repository calls; internally calls gcp_git_content.validate_selection(commit, paths).
integration_hooks.public_shape: Exactly one list entry with exactly repository, commit and paths keys; repository=projects/PROJECT_ID/repos/NAME, commit=40 lowercase hexadecimal immutable SHA1, paths=list of 1..8 distinct normalized relative UTF8 POSIX file paths.
integration_hooks.scope: Exactly one explicit canonical project ID scope, projects/PROJECT_ID; project numbers, multi-scope selections, URLs, branches/tags and wildcard repositories are rejected.
integration_hooks.gate: content_secret_scans is True and _content_secret_scan_kinds is a list containing source_repository_file
integration_hooks.job_result: [(source_repository_file, scope, sourcerepo, lambda: collection_pages(collector, scope))] when enabled; [] otherwise
integration_hooks.ordering: Run after the complete project collection; no bucket/source-repository inventory dependency.

metadata_contract.source_repository_file_selection: {repository, commit, paths_sha256:[SHA256(exact path UTF8), ...]} or null when disabled

integration_hooks.pages: collection_pages(collector, scope), emitting all native/read receipt references into the envelope
integration_hooks.install_semantics: Explicit idempotent registration and same-prefix gzip fixture load; no import-time installation in the owned module.
root_owned: collector jobs and context metadata hooks

native_contract.project: Reuses gcp_cloudbuild_log_secret_indicators._project and enforces numeric CRM native identity, canonical projectId, complete identity fields and one native source request.
native_contract.metadata: Dedicated uncached GET https://sourcerepo.googleapis.com/v1/{selected repository}, params fields=name,url; exact final prepared URL and empty redirect history required.
native_contract.binding: Repo response has exactly name and url, matching selected canonical native repository and constructed source.developers.google.com/p/PROJECT_ID/r/NAME clone URL exactly before Git.
native_contract.quota_project: Only validated configured quota_project or native credential x-goog-user-project is forwarded to the fixed Google API origin; unrelated headers and quota headers are not sent to Git.
native_contract.git: Reuses gcp_git_transport.fetch_pack with enabled=True and the shared monotonic deadline; only constructed fixed-host advertisement GET and upload-pack POST; exact advertised immutable commit required.
native_contract.auth: Basic username git-service-account with existing OAuth2 token as password; no helper execution. Primary historical contract pinned in source-repositories-native-contract-review.json auth_followup revision bcf66f086d941724b77eac6eb7d8eba085efc34e.
native_contract.decode: Reuses gcp_git_content.decode_selected_files on in-memory PACK and exact selected commit/path bytes with the same deadline and cancellation checks.

consumer_validation: Strict one selected scope and one own collection/item
Independent selection digest and authorized metadata equality
Native canonical project and repository/clone URL binding
Exactly one native project reference and three owned successful read receipts
Final native GET plus fixed Git GET/upload-pack POST route proof, method, operation, owner, scope, count, status and bounded bytes
Per-file path SHA256, exact immutable-commit/blob/byte identity and complete parser accounting
Exactly pinned complete Kingfisher and TruffleHog outcomes for every selected file
Strict redacted merged fingerprints and opaque selected-path-only locations

limits.wire_scope: Coordinator confirmed: Git advertisement plus upload-pack <=8MiB; native Repo GET separately <=16KiB; total source traffic <=8MiB+16KiB excluding previously collected project metadata.

privacy: No repository clone, checkout, Git subprocess, helper, hook, filter, credential reconfiguration, LFS dereference, receive-pack, cloud writes, generic REST allowlist expansion, credentials discovery or real cloud query.
Source/PACK bytes remain within ephemeral in-memory adapter/decoder locals and are excluded from retained transport cache/evidence/error strings.
Exact selected path strings are represented only by SHA256 in marker metadata, scanner labels, finding locations and retained cache state.
Existing scanner-private ephemeral input handling is reused; this report does not claim that scanner temporary input never exists.
Only redacted exact-value HMAC fingerprints, counts, bounded object identities and static reasons survive.
coverage: Only exact selected regular UTF8 text blobs at the exact advertised immutable commit; does not establish repository-wide/history secret absence or selected-file-only wire transfer.

validation.method: Direct test function calls under separate pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() blocks; no pytest runner/session invoked by this worker.

real_scanners.offline_flags: TruffleHog no-verification/no-update/no-verification-cache and packaged Kingfisher scanning only

validation.unmocked_sockets: socket.socket.connect and socket.create_connection reject unexpected network calls in native fixture tests
validation.quota_header_tests: configured/native header forwarding and malformed value rejection
validation.fixtures: pass/fail generated by real offline pinned scanners; unknown/missing/malformed included; gzip mtime=0; no plaintext selected path or test secret retained
validation.central_pytest: Root owned and not invoked by this worker

remaining: Live current CSR authentication/provider compatibility remains unverified; no live cloud or repository request was performed
coordinator_budget_resolution: Use Git advertisement plus upload-pack wire <=8 MiB, with the native Repo GET separately capped at16 KiB. State both limits explicitly; total source traffic is <=8 MiB+16 KiB, excluding the already collected project metadata. No wire_budget API expansion is needed.
